purpose: City-specific official registry/cadastre and safe anonymous parcel-geometry discovery.
assessment: The city Geoportal is a public GeoNode catalogue with WFS/WMS capabilities, but its visible and indexed materials did not identify a parcel layer. Official city sources confirm local land-office activity and mapping, but no anonymous parcel feature response or schema was found.
registryAssessment: Pontianak City’s official Geoportal publishes geospatial information from city agencies, and the city government identifies the municipal ATR/BPN land office as the land-registration authority. No publicly available parcel-cadastre layer was identified in the Geoportal search.
